query_text: Our beloved colleague Stephen is now leaving the company. He is one of the best engineers we had. He used to love posting memes. Write a short, fun and inspiring goodbye message.

content.text:
Here's a short, fun, and inspiring goodbye message for Stephen:

---

🎉 **So long, Stephen — but what a ride it's built!** 🎉

They say the best engineers don't just write code — they leave *legacy*. And Stephen, you've left us with more than just clean commits and brilliant solutions — you've left us with laughter, memes that *perfectly* captured every Monday morning standup, and a standard of excellence we'll all be chasing! 😄

From debugging the toughest problems to dropping the most relatable meme at exactly the right moment, you made this team not just better — but *funnier* and more human. 🙌

As you close this chapter and boot up the next one, remember: **the world is your IDE, and the possibilities are infinite.** Go build something amazing — we know you will. 🚀

And hey, wherever you land, don't forget to keep sending us those memes. Some things should *never* be deprecated. 😂

We'll miss you more than a Friday deploy (*and that's saying something!*) 💙

**Best of luck, Stephen — the legend leaves the building, but never our hearts!** 🌟

---

*P.S. — You better keep us updated. We expect nothing less than a highlight reel.* 😎
